context: Initial scaffold with members=[] and no Cargo.lock failed all 6 required checks. Fix: bitty-ai-core placeholder crate plus committed Cargo.lock. Lesson: never push a Rust workspace without at least one member and lockfile.
title: Empty workspace breaks all locked CI jobs

consequences: Direct merges without closeout will trip the gate; fix is publish + rerun, as done here (e2df253, rerun success).
context: 2026-09-14: bitty-ai#14 merged directly to main (edee2ad) without snapshot closeout; Snapshot-source gate failed with snapshot at 13f0306 behind main.
decision_body: Every merge to main MUST be followed immediately by just workflow-publish from updated main plus a snapshot-source green check before the owning task is completed. Whoever merges owns this step.
rationale: The gate compares snapshot source against main HEAD; any main advance without a fresh snapshot trips it. Publishing first, then verifying, keeps main green.
title: Snapshot must be published before merge closeout completes
